ai_review.summary: Urgent, upbeat show with standout Mason's Children, Black Peter and Pigpen numbers; recording quality unknown but generally praised
ai_review.review: Fans describe this performance as full of urgency and energy, highlighting strong renditions of Mason's Children, Black Peter, China Cat Sunflower and a hot Pigpen set featuring Hard to Handle, Good Lovin' and Lovelight. While the audio source isn’t specified, reviewers consistently rate the listening experience positively.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are positive (4‑5 stars) and emphasize strong musical moments; lack of technical detail limits confidence to medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on soundboard vs. audience or specific audio clarity, but overall impression is that the recording sounds nice.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as urgent with many upbeat rockers, featuring a strong Black Peter and an especially hot Pigpen segment.
